mission_06: Excellent work implementing comprehensive stationarity tests! You now have the statistical tools to rigorously assess whether a time series meets the stationarity assumption required by many forecasting methods. The ADF test and KPSS test provide complementary perspectives: the ADF tests for the presence of a unit root (null: non-stationary), while KPSS tests for stationarity around a trend (null: stationary). Using both tests together gives a more complete picture, as agreement between them provides strong evidence, while disagreement suggests the series may be trend-stationary or have structural breaks. The partial autocorrelation function computed via Durbin-Levinson recursion is essential for identifying the order of autoregressive models. These tools form the diagnostic foundation for any serious time series analysis workflow.
